name: HubSpot Service Hub
oneLiner: Customer service software on the HubSpot CRM: help desk, tickets, knowledge base, customer portal, feedback surveys and the Breeze Customer Agent AI.
bestFor: Teams that already use HubSpot for marketing or sales and want support conversations on the same customer record.

customers.name: Twelve (ordering and payments app; partner case study)

updates.text: Breeze Customer Agent made available to all Pro and Enterprise customers across hubs through HubSpot Credits, covering the whole buyer journey; HubSpot said it helped customers resolve over 50% of support tickets.
Help desk gained assignment-workflow routing (e.g. VIP or language-based routing, conditional Customer Agent handoffs) and a Coaching Opportunities page for Customer Agent.

features: Help desk workspace for email, chat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and calling channels
Breeze Customer Agent AI that answers from your knowledge base and hands off to people
Knowledge base and customer portal for self-service
Ticket routing, SLAs and automation workflows
NPS, CSAT and CES feedback surveys
Every conversation logged on the shared HubSpot CRM record

pricing.text: Free tools available. Paid plans are per seat: HubSpot's pricing page lists Professional at $90/seat/month and Enterprise at $150/seat/month; the Starter rate changes with promotions, so check the page. AI agent usage draws on HubSpot Credits.

notes: hubspot.com could not be fetched; prices come from search snippets of the official page. Starter price conflicts across sources ($7, $15, $20 per seat), so the review doesn't quote it. The original's $15/seat Starter price was dropped. Calling channel requires Professional or Enterprise. Twelve is a partner-written (Webs) case study.
